items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: on clarinet it would be Edmond Hall and let me think, you’ve got the idea. This is the Eddie Condon type player.

ctx.x: Neat. Do you have favorite Dixieland musicians yourself?

Yes. I would say Wild Bill Davison, Bobby Hackett on cornet and on trombone I would say Cutty Cutshall and Lou McGarrity, on clarinet it would be Edmond Hall and let me think, you’ve got the idea. This is the Eddie Condon type player.
Right, right. Do you make a distinction between New Orleans Dixieland and what came after when it went to Chicago? Does it sound different to you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
